name: PDF4me
description:
PDF4me delivers an intelligent and efficient solution for all your PDFs.
Boost your productivity with PDF4me: access crucial data, make edits, and convert files to PDFs directly —all in Claude. From single-document conversion to mega data files, PDF4me is there.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PDF4me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PDF4me to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pdf4me.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PDF4me MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDF4me provides these MCP tools: compress_pdf, convert_pdf_to_excel, convert_pdf_to_image, convert_pdf_to_powerpoint, convert_pdf_to_word, convert_to_pdf, and extract_resources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PDF4me?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PDF4me in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PDF4me requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PDF4me is developed by PDF4me Team. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
